messages:
Marta H: quick q — I'm preparing the 4:00 UTC canary report. Where do folks look for per-GPU SM% (short-window), per-process GPU memory, kvcache hitrate by model, and avg tokens/sec per batch? need panel links or prom/loki queries, preferably per-pod/model.

Ryan C: hi Marta — best starting point is the gpu-summary dashboard we keep in Grafana. panels I usually grab: SM% = panel 7, mem per process = panel 12, kvcache hitrate heatmap = panel 21. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gpu-summary/gpu-summary?orgId=1

Sasha P: for prom queries — SM% (1m avg) i use something like
```
avg by (gpu) (rate(gpu_sm_utilization_percent[1m]))
```
for per-container mem:
```
avg by (pod,container) (gpu_memory_bytes_used / gpu_memory_bytes_total)
```
kvcache hitrate by model (approx):
```
sum by (model) (rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
avg tokens/sec per batch is annoyingly custom — we ingest batch latency + token_count metrics. i compute:
```
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model) / sum(rate(batches_processed_total[1m])) by (model)
```

Marta H: this is perfect, thanks. do we have a Loki query for kvcache evictions that shows model and pod? saw a spike around 03:50 UTC.

Sasha P: yep:
```
{job=\"kvcache\"} |= \"evict\" | json | line_format \"{{.time}} {{.model}} {{.pod}} {{.reason}}\"
```
that shows pod and model if the log JSON includes them. if not, try: `|~ \"model=|pod=\"` to regex parse.

Lucas B: fwiw the spike at 03:50 matched a big batched eval from canary-model-v2 — evictions increased when batch_size jumped to 512. we probably want to watch batch size distribution on the canary traffic.

Marta H: can we add a short Grafana panel that surfaces batch_size histogram and a per-model eviction rate? will file a tiny PR but want owner ping — who owns the gpu-summary dashboard?

Ryan C: dashboard is owned by eng-runtime (me + Sasha). go ahead and open the PR against dashboards/gpu-summary, ping @Sasha P and @Ryan C. for alert tuning: which alert was noisy?

Marta H: the gpu_memory_high alert on p3s fired twice last hour in short bursts. it's threshold=80% for 2m. Ops asked to reduce noise. suggestion: bump to 85% and increase duration to 5m, or scope to per-pool rather than global.

Lucas B: i'd prefer increasing duration to 5m first. bursts from batching cause transient spikes but not sustained OOM risk. bump to 85% if we still see churn.

Sasha P: agree. open a tiny ops PR to change `gpu_memory_high` -> `for: 5m` and set threshold to `85`. include a note referencing canary run id `canary/2026-03-17/03:45`. I'll review.

Marta H: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dashboards/pull/512 — small chan­ge, changing threshold and for. pinging reviewers.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary traffic split 5% -> canary-model-v2 at 2026-03-17T03:46:10Z (id: deploy-7890).

Ryan C: (thumbsup) after PR merges, i'll update the on-call runbook and add the kvcache eviction panel to the summary row so it's visible on pager view.

Marta H: awesome. last ask — any quick way to get a per-model per-pod table for the 4:00 report? if not i'll export the prom queries above and join offline.

Sasha P: quick method: use the `Explore` view in Grafana, run the queries with `by (model,pod)` and then use the table transform. i can export a CSV if you want.

Marta H: please, a CSV would be great. thanks all! :party_parrot:
